project_type: Halo CMS-based water conservancy engineering company website with custom theme and mock data. Company specializes in hydraulic/water conservancy engineering (水利工程).
build_system: Static files - no build step required. Docker Compose for deployment.
test_framework: No automated tests - visual verification via file structure validation
test_command: N/A - validate file structure and syntax
verification_instructions: Verify all required files exist, YAML is valid, HTML templates are well-formed, CSS is complete
setup_instructions: No setup needed - greenfield project creating static files
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot pull Docker images or external packages. All files are static content (HTML, CSS, JS, YAML, Markdown). No runtime dependencies needed for file creation.
key_patterns: Halo 2.x theme structure with Thymeleaf templates, theme.yaml for config, settings.yaml for options, templates/ for pages, assets/ for static files
directory_structure: company-home/ - root with README, docker-compose, .env; theme-engineering-company/ - Halo theme; init-data/ - mock data; docs/ - documentation
